known_limitations: No live SQL Server integration test performed in this environment
GIS UI currently uses local rectangular X/Y coordinates, not an interactive map
IoT batch TVP upload not implemented
UC05 SQL source has no dedicated status-update procedure for DataAnomalies; the web UI does not write directly to that table
No live SQL Server integration test performed; SQL scripts and web workflows need verification against the user SQL Server instance
UC07 JSON adapter uses OPENJSON and therefore requires SQL Server 2016+ with database compatibility level 130 or later
No live SQL Server integration test performed in this environment; user must test against local SQL Server
CSRF protection and login/activation rate limiting still need production hardening
SMTP delivery is not integrated in the web app; activation/notification emails are queued in EmailOutbox only
UC02 IoT batch TVP and interactive GIS map remain incomplete

UC10 SQL source behavior is preserved: usp_Dash_Summary/LoadProfile do not filter IsComplete=1; LoadProfile flags incomplete buckets, Heatmap filters IsComplete=1, Report_Consumption filters ValidCount>0. Review SQL if strict BR08 requires stronger filtering
